en.name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
en.description: Centralised portal for central/state/UT scholarship schemes with application, verification, and DBT.
en.eligibility: Students meeting scheme-specific criteria (merit, income, category, institution).
en.benefits: Single-window scholarships; direct benefit transfer to bank account.
